'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] items. 

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Dropped by the [[Hijacked Golem]].

== ''Usage'' ==
Can be smelted back into a normal Iron Ingot.
Used to create a [[Modules#Hijacked Module|Hijacked Module]], [[Hijacked Iron Tools]] and [[Hijacked Iron Armor]].
